Q1.answer: For this release the downstream transport is rveval.veritas-input.v1 carrying a typed RCCDecision and exact CandidateAction, not the old scored Pilot report. This is a versioned external integration surface, not a private production artifact.

Q2.answer: RCC ADOPT offers exactly one candidate; HOLD and REJECT offer none. ERROR and UNSUPPORTED are execution/capability failures. Native VERITAS proceed/block/escalate/COMMITTED are separate namespaces. No free enum translation.

Q3.answer: identities.rcc_decision_sha256 commits RCCDecision.to_dict under rveval.python-finite-json.v2 (canonical UTF-8 finite JSON). payload_sha256 commits only payload. packet_created_at is an aware packet-creation timestamp, NOT an invented upstream decision time. Native decision_id/hash/ts are assigned and verified by native CDA. Hash verification is not origin authentication; independent native receipt verifier remains required.

Q4.answer: Original request id, source observation ref, RCC decision digest, candidate digest, native request id, native decision id/hash and execution intent id are distinct. NativeDecisionIntentFactory journals both native and upstream candidate hashes; exact original source refs stay attached in the packet. They must not be renamed into one another.

Q5.answer: The external RCC path verifies/adopts; NativeBindExecutor is the sole effect owner for this joint path. Native worker paths with other effect owners must explicitly select the review-only surface. Do not combine effectful Bind with benchmark apply again.

Q6.answer: CandidateAction supports tool_call/final_answer/structured_action/message/custom/batch/model_request/artifact. Its name, arguments, content, metadata retain typed JSON. Non-JSON native values use NativeView or an explicit source-pinned projection while actual objects stay with the native runtime. target/action-contract come from independent typed operation mapping, not text.

Q7.answer: ExternalRCCGate verification carries check_id, required flag, source-pinned callable, report scope and evidence_refs; policy and gate source hashes are in the decision body. Packet time is separate from verifier event time. A verifier without a signed timestamp is not described as signed.

Q8.answer: source_refs carries origin/ref/sha256 for original measurement artifacts without replacing their origin with RCC. This joint evaluation does not require NeoMundi; an empty list means no original measurement supplied, not measurement verified. No upstream signal is converted to native authority.

Q9.answer: Only the explicit typed adoption/lineage/no-authority semantics in this release are fixed. ExternalRCCGate is a bounded verification/adoption runtime with pluggable verifier, not all private RCC routing/executor behavior. Historical Pilot scores and schemas are not asserted to have production parity.

scope: Implemented external integration contract. Dynamic native governance and semantic-verifier behavior are component-owner inputs, not invented by transport.
